args: A simple petal. Not too strong, not too weak.
It's very light and recharges quickly, at the cost of damage.
This one makes your petals spin faster.
A more chunky petal that hits harder but takes longer to recharge.
A fragile petal that deals lots of damage.
A bit weak, but recharges instantly.
It's a rock, not much to say about it.
A petal that gives you extra health. Pretty magical if you ask me.
A petal that heals you over time by the power of photosynthesis.
A petal that reduces incoming damage.
The extra soil slows you down a bit...
A purely magical petal that heals you over time while simultaneously making you tougher.
It's a piece of corn. They say ants like to snack on it.
Some fine grains of sand. They recharge quickly and can pack a punch.
A bunch of oranges. They're pretty juicy.
You can actually shoot this one!
Not great at combat, but it's healing properties are amazing.
It makes you sneeze. Don't drop it!
It's sticky and will slow your enemies down.
Packs an unexpected punch in its secret weapon: poison.
Through the eye of the beholder comes extra range.
Poisonous, and it slows down your enemies. A perfect double whammy.
Something might pop out of this!
These feelers give you some extra vision.
A pod of peas. They'll explode if you're not careful.
A bundle of sticks... I wonder what'll happen if you spin them around in the desert...
Said to be from a mystical covenant of witches who specialized in healing nature.
A tome of ancient spells. It's said to be able to focus the power of a fallen Demon.
A petal that channels the power of all that came before.
This special cocaine will make you go fast!
A petal that spawns ants. They'll help you out!
A strange leaf that heals you but only when you're in defensive mode.
This petal's magnetic field will attract nearby items. Does not stack.
What an oddity! It's said to reflect a portion of incoming conventional damage. Does not stack.
Super not bouncy! Does not knocks all your enemies around. Very useless.
The tree of life. If you were to die with this petal alive, you'd be revived with a portion of your health.
A shard of glass that phases through enemies.
It absorbs conventional damage done to your flower. If incoming damage is too great, you will suffer all of the damage the sponge has contained at once.
A pearl that can be placed on the ground. You can call it back to you at any time.
A shell that provides extra protection through a shield.
It will boost you when you pop it.
Literally nothing at all, but it puffs you up.
A leg of a starfish. It will heal you quite effectively while you are under 70% health.
The fang of a dangerous Leech. It will heal back the damage it causes.
This sticky goo isn't good for you...
A steaming pile of shi- I mean, poo.
Mobs will prioritize your shiny bulb when in use. The priority increases with each rarity, and stacks with itself.
A battery that can release electric charges when its parent is hit.
A cloud of dust that can be launched at enemies.
This petal greatly protects you, but at a cost...
Extra HP with a bonus: poison!
This fragile lantern shines so bright...
A fragile branch from the Wilt.
Summons leeches to help protect you!
Hey wait a minute... This isn't a Beetle Egg!
Sharp against the strong, weak against the weak.
Has a 5% chance of dealing 20x damage. Criticals will only apply if the base dice damage is higher than the mob armor. Suggested by: Climbo
Some fine grains of sand on fire. They deal 3x damage than normal sand. Suggested by: Climbo
A really hard piece of rock. Suggested by: Amditorium
This shiny cactus will give you 5x extra health than normal cactus and his sharp thorns will deal massive damage. Suggested by: Mega nob
Where did you get this? Suggested by: climbo
